While it modifies download behavior, it does not alter the control flow of `makepkg --printsrcinfo` itself, which does not perform downloads.

No top-level command substitutions, function definitions, or immediate executions are present. All logic is confined to the `package()` function, which is not executed during this phase. Thus, parsing this PKGBUILD is safe.
</details>
